evidence.title: Conformal Risk Minimization for Semi-Supervised Domain Adaptation via Optimal Transport

summary: Researchers introduced a conformal risk minimization framework that leverages optimal transport to improve semi‑supervised domain adaptation, allowing models to better generalize across shifted data distributions with limited labeled data. Experiments demonstrate state‑of‑the‑art performance on benchmark tasks, highlighting the approach’s robustness and theoretical guarantees.
title: New Method Combines Conformal Risk Minimization and Optimal Transport for Semi‑Supervised Domain Adaptation
